sentences.en: Producers used to be strict about not breaking the fourth wall, but now they have no choice but to let the outside world into the frame.

sentences.en: It used to be that the real story was not that there are people watching a TV show, Baskin told me.

sentences.en: But part of Tom
sentences.zh: 但汤姆

sentences.en: Sandoval's real experience in life right now is that he's not just facing an ex-girlfriend or a friend group upset with him, he's facing the entire nation.
sentences.zh: 桑多瓦尔目前在生活中的真实经历一部分是，他不仅要面对前女友或对他不满的朋友群，还要面对整个国家。

sentences.en: As filming for the new season got underway, Bravo had a problem.
sentences.zh: 随着新一季拍摄的展开，Bravo遇到一个问题。

sentences.en: But he was no longer talking to

sentences.zh: “我们依然能从中榨出一季精彩的节目，”他说。

sentences.zh: “但往后看，我不知道。”

sentences.zh: 列维斯是唯一没有回归第
11季的主要演员。

sentences.zh: 她的团队打听了加薪的事，并透露了列维斯获得Bravo开发协议的可能性。

sentences.en: Through a representative, Levis emphasized that mental health protections were her primary concern.
sentences.zh: 通过发言人，列维斯强调心理健康保护是她首要关心的事。

sentences.en: Then, in August, after spending 90 days in the
sentences.zh: 接着，在八月，在亚利桑那州的机构呆了90天并将名字从雷奎尔改回出生名瑞秋后，列维斯出现在伯莎妮·弗兰克尔的播客中。弗兰克尔是前纽约真实家庭主妇。

sentences.zh: 弗兰克尔是前纽约真实家庭主妇。

sentences.en: Last summer, she declared what she called the reality reckoning, accusing Bravo and other networks of profiting off a
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，她宣布了她所谓的“真人秀清算”，指责Bravo和其他电视台利用其节目创造的有害环境牟利，却没有对明星给予适当的补偿。

sentences.en: harmful environment created by their shows without properly compensating their stars.
sentences.zh: 害环境创造的有害环境牟利，却没有对明星给予适当的补偿。

sentences.en: She invited others to join her and teamed up with two prominent attorneys, Mark Garagos and Brian Friedman.
sentences.zh: 她邀请其他人加入，并与两位杰出的律师马克·加拉戈斯和布莱恩·弗里德曼合作。

sentences.en: No actual lawsuits have been filed, but NBCUniversal subsequently issued updated guidelines for its production companies, including additional psychological support for cast
sentences.zh: 虽然没有提起实际诉讼，但NBC环球随后为其制作公司发布了更新的指南，包括为演员

sentences.en: members.
sentences.zh: 成员提供额外的心理支持。

sentences.en: Part of Frankel's arsenal was a three-part interview with Levis, who described how she felt exploited by Sandoval and Bravo for ratings without seeing a single penny.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克尔的杀手锏之一是对列维斯的三部分采访，列维斯在采访中描述了她如何觉得被桑多瓦尔和Bravo利用来赚取收视率，却连一分钱也没看到。

sentences.en: Baskin told me that Levis was paid $19,000 per episode for 18 episodes and that news of the affair came out after the season wrapped.
sentences.zh: 巴斯金告诉我，列维斯在18集的节目中每集片酬为1.9万美元，而关于外遇的消息是在整季拍完后才曝光的。

sentences.en: Are we supposed to give her retroactive payment for having a clandestine affair for eight months?
sentences.zh: 难道我们要因为她维持了八个月的地下情而给她支付追溯报酬吗？

sentences.en: He asked.
sentences.zh: 他问。

sentences.en: Frankel would basically argue yes.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克尔基本上会回答“是”。

sentences.zh: 七月罢工并加入编剧行列，她呼吁真人秀明星成立工会，这样他们也能获得后续分红，并从一季节目的成功中分得一杯羹。

sentences.en: But while everyone I talked to agreed that regulations would be a good thing, no one was sure how it would work exactly.
sentences.zh: 但尽管我交谈过的所有人都认为出台规章制度是件好事，却没人知道具体该如何运作。

sentences.en: Part of the appeal of reality TV is that it's relatively cheap to make, as low as $250,000 per episode versus $2 million for scripted TV.
sentences.zh: 真人秀吸引人的部分原因在于其制作成本相对低廉，每集仅需25万美元左右，而有剧本电视则高达200万美元。

sentences.en: The draw for all parties involved is that its stars are often plucked from relative obscurity.
sentences.zh: 对所有相关各方来说，吸引力在于其明星往往是从相对默默无闻中被发掘出来的。

sentences.en: It's probably good for the business to have some protections, Revel, Sandoval's manager, told me.
sentences.zh: 桑多瓦尔的经纪人雷维尔告诉我：“建立一些保护措施对这个行业来说可能是件好事。”

sentences.en: Will it happen?
sentences.zh: “会实现吗？”

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: “我不知道。”

sentences.en: But no one is walking off set.
sentences.zh: “但没有人会罢工离场。”

sentences.en: I didn't see Sandoval for about two weeks.
sentences.zh: 我有大约两周没见到桑多瓦尔了。

sentences.en: Then, on a Monday in December, I drove to a soundstage in Burbank where he was taping his next confessional interview for the show.
sentences.zh: 然后，在十二月的一个周一，我开车去了伯班克的一个摄影棚，他在那里为节目录制他的下一场独白采访。

sentences.en: Riley wasn't here this time.
sentences.zh: 瑞利这次没来。

sentences.en: Instead, we were joined by a Bravo publicist and Erika Forstat, a senior NBCUniversal executive.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，陪同我们的是一位Bravo的公关和NBC环球的高级高管埃里卡·福斯特拉特。

sentences.en: My clue that this wasn't typical was when Forstat introduced herself to Sandoval.
sentences.zh: 我察觉到这很不寻常的迹象是福斯特拉特向桑多瓦尔自我介绍的时候。

sentences.en: You once made me a wonderful mocktail at Schwartz and Sandy's, she said.
sentences.zh: “你曾在Schwartz and Sandy's为我做过一杯很棒的无酒精鸡尾酒，”她说。

sentences.en: Sandoval was in a small dressing room, applying dabs of makeup to his forehead.
sentences.zh: 桑多瓦尔待在一个小化妆室里，正往额头上点着粉底。

sentences.en: In front of him were three caffeinated beverages, a Red Bull, an iced coffee, and a Dr. Pepper.
sentences.zh: 摆在他面前的是三款含咖啡因的饮料：红牛、冰咖啡和胡椒博士。

sentences.en: He sipped each intermittently.
sentences.zh: 他间歇性地啜饮着每一种饮料。

sentences.en: Sandoval said he was feeling depressed.
sentences.zh: 桑多瓦尔说他感到很沮丧。

sentences.en: He said the same thing the last time I saw him.
sentences.zh: 我上次见到他时他也这么说。

sentences.en: When I asked if the depression was show-related, he had said, somewhat show-related, just life, business stuff, it's hard.
sentences.zh: 当我问及这种沮丧是否与节目有关时，他曾说：“有点和节目相关吧，就是生活、商业方面的事，这很难。”

sentences.en: Sandoval began to perform loud vocal exercises.
sentences.zh: 桑多瓦尔开始大声进行声乐练习。

sentences.en: He applied pomade to his hair, combing it back with his fingers, and changed into a light blue women's suit from Zara, which he said he preferred to the store's menswear.
sentences.zh: 他往头发上抹了发油，用手指将其向后梳去，并换上了一套来自扎拉的浅蓝色女式西装，他说他比该店的男装更喜欢这套衣服。

sentences.en: The suit looked good, but the sleeves barely reached his wrists.
sentences.zh: 这套西装看起来很不错，但袖子勉强够到他的手腕。

sentences.en: As he emerged from the dressing room, there was something about the suit's feminine cut, combined with Sandoval's physique and slightly hunched posture,
sentences.zh: 当他从化妆室走出来时，西装女性化的剪裁，加上桑多瓦尔的体型和微微佝偻的姿态，

sentences.en: that reminded me of Heath Ledger's Joker in the scene at the hospital where he wears a nurse's uniform.
sentences.zh: 让他让我想起希斯·莱杰在医院里穿着护士制服那一幕中的小丑。

sentences.en: It's hard to tell how Sandoval feels about filming the show.
sentences.zh: 很难说桑多瓦尔对拍摄这个节目有何感受。

sentences.en: Sometimes he sounded down on it.
sentences.zh: 有时他听起来对它很消极。

sentences.en: It has its fun moments, but for the most part, it sucks.
sentences.zh: “它有有趣的时候，但大多数时候，它糟透了。”

sentences.en: I've been buzzed through most of it.
sentences.zh: “我一路迷迷糊糊地撑过了大部分拍摄。”

sentences.en: Other times, he told me he would do it for as long as he possibly could.
sentences.zh: 有时，他告诉我他会尽可能长久地拍下去。

sentences.en: There was a point last year when he considered quitting, but he was glad he didn't.
sentences.zh: 去年曾有一段时间他考虑过退出，但他很高兴自己没有这么做。

sentences.en: He wasn't at all envious of Levis, who walked away from the cameras, albeit not very far, as she has started her own podcast, Rachel Goes Rogue.
sentences.zh: 他对离开摄像机的列维斯一点也不羡慕，虽然她没走远，因为她开创了自己的播客《瑞秋出走记》。

sentences.en: So far, the primary theme has been Sandoval.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，主要的主题依然是桑多瓦尔。

sentences.en: Sandoval figured she would be back in a season or two.
sentences.zh: 桑多瓦尔觉得她在一两季内就会回来。

sentences.en: What else is she going to do?
sentences.zh: “她还能做什么？”

sentences.en: The evolution set, where confessionals are taped, is designed to look like another room in Sur.
sentences.zh: 录制独白的Evolution布景被设计得看起来像Sur餐厅的另一个房间。

sentences.en: There are deep purple curtains, a mirrored dresser, and lots of gold and velvet.
sentences.zh: 那里有深紫色的窗帘、一面带镜子的梳妆台，以及大量的金色和天鹅绒。

sentences.en: Production for the new season wrapped in September, but interviews are taped for months afterward to get the cast's reactions to what occurred.
sentences.zh: 新一季的制作于九月杀青，但随后的几个月里仍在录制采访，以获取演员对所发生事情的反应。

sentences.en: The showrunner began by asking Sandoval about a tasting led by a water sommelier that everyone attended in AuguSt. Had Sandoval ever heard of a water tasting?
sentences.zh: 节目主持人首先问及桑多瓦尔关于八月份大家参加的由水品鉴师主持的品水会。桑多瓦尔以前听说过品水会吗？

sentences.en: I have never even remotely heard of a water tasting before in my life, Sandoval said.
sentences.zh: 桑多瓦尔说：“我这辈子连听都没听说过什么品水会。”

sentences.en: He tried again.
sentences.zh: 他又试着解释了一遍。

sentences.en: I have never heard of or been to a water tasting, but here we are.
sentences.zh: “我从来没听说过也没有参加过品水会，但我们现在来了。”

sentences.en: Sandoval hoped his luck would turn this season.
sentences.zh: 桑多瓦尔希望这季他的运气能有所好转。

sentences.en: It's probably why he agreed to speak with me in the first place.
sentences.zh: 这大概就是他最初同意跟我谈话的原因。

sentences.en: When I last talked to him, he was feeling optimistic.
sentences.zh: 我上次跟他谈话时，他感觉很乐观。

sentences.en: He'd been meditating and was about to go back on tour with his band.
sentences.zh: 他一直在冥想，准备和他的乐队重新开始巡演。

sentences.en: Plus, he was single now, which could be a whole new storyline for him on the show.
sentences.zh: 另外，他现在单身了，这可能会成为他在节目中的全新故事线。

sentences.en: It's the first time I've ever been single as a celebrity, he told me.
sentences.zh: 这是我成为名人以来第一次单身，他告诉我。

sentences.en: I'm not saying
sentences.zh: 我不是说

sentences.en: I'm a favorite celebrity, but still, just having some notoriety and being single, it's a cool muscle to flex.
sentences.zh: 我是个红人，不过话说回来，既有点名气又是单身，这种感觉挺酷的。

sentences.en: Though he had come to Los Angeles to be an actor, he was proud of what he became instead.
sentences.zh: 虽然他来洛杉矶是为了当演员，但他为自己最终取得的成就感到自豪。

sentences.en: Did he become the next Brad Pitt?
sentences.zh: 他成了下一个布拉德·皮特吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: But he didn't want to be that anymore anyway.
sentences.zh: 不过反正他也不想再当那种人了。

sentences.en: It turned out reality TV is where the real stakes are.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，真人秀才是真正充满风险的地方。

sentences.en: Actors were just pretending, playing roles.
sentences.zh: 演员只是在假装，在扮演角色。

sentences.en: I had no respect for reality TV before, Sandoval told me.
sentences.zh: 桑多瓦尔告诉我，我以前对真人秀一点敬意都没有。

sentences.en: And now, I don't have very much respect for actors.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我对演员也没多少敬意了。

sentences.en: I'm like, y'all try doing this.
sentences.zh: 我想说，你们有本事来试试这个。

sentences.en: Of course he knew it wasn't going to last forever.
sentences.zh: 当然，他知道这不会永远持续下去。

sentences.en: But if he kept at it and rehabilitated his image, there could be life beyond his first show.
sentences.zh: 但如果他坚持下去并重塑形象，他的第一档节目之后或许还会有新的人生。

sentences.en: There were brand deals to be had, as well as reality spinoffs and competition shows.
sentences.zh: 还有品牌代言可以接，以及真人秀衍生节目和竞技类节目。

sentences.en: Though if he was going to do another reality series, he would like it to be something more feel-good.
sentences.zh: 不过如果要拍另一档真人秀系列，他希望是那种能让人心情舒畅的内容。

sentences.en: Our show can be toxic to film, he said, and very stressful.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们的节目拍起来可能很有毒，而且压力非常大。

sentences.en: Despite this, he was as committed to it as ever, and hoped it would continue for a while.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他一如既往地投入其中，并希望它能继续播下去。

sentences.en: As long as people are interested, he told me, and we're being honest in our feels.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，只要大家还感兴趣，而且我们在真情流露。

sentences.en: That's what he was doing now, sitting in front of the camera, in a powder blue suit, and sunless tanner, being honest in his feels.
sentences.zh: 这就是他现在正在做的事，身穿浅蓝色西装，涂着美黑霜，坐在镜头前真情流露。

sentences.en: I watched him on a monitor as he peered into the lens, with one eyebrow slightly raised.
sentences.zh: 我通过监视器看着他凝视着镜头，微微挑起一侧眉毛。

sentences.en: Then the camera rolled, and his face lit up with a big, genuine smile.
sentences.zh: 接着镜头开始转动，他的脸庞绽放出灿烂而真诚的笑容。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器在运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了这批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党便陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时甚至令人兴奋的权力争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，由我萨拉·科尼格为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在这个过程中失控的故事。
